MRP Percentage Control:
1. By Default, system will generate MRP to the percentage defined under “MRP%” of above grid.
2. This percentage will be followed up to the days given “MRP Release Days”. MRP release days will be calculated from First MRP Run Date. For example if “MRP Release Days” is set to 20 and First MRP run date is 1st Sep 2026 then will automatically make MRP % as 100 on 21st Sep 2026.

candidates.text:
Error Handling and Monitoring for MRP Run:
1. In case of any error during MRP execution, the system should capture and log the error details.
2. A separate screen should be provided for users to monitor MRP run errors.
3. This screen should display:
4. Article / OC reference
5. MRP run date and time
6. Execution status (Success/Failed)
7. Detailed error messages
8. Users should be able to analyze the errors and take corrective actions from this screen.
9. The system should also allow users to reprocess/re-run MRP after resolving the issues.
10. Additionally, users should have the provision to manually trigger MRP for specific articles/OCs in urgent scenarios, even before the scheduled run.

chunks.title: Purpose
chunks.heading: Purpose
chunks.text: Purpose of this document is to describe understanding of MRP automation and certain enhancements required for Shahi Exports. These enhancements will also increase product capabilities in terms of automation and functional capabilities.
chunks.locator: § Purpose

chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: Business Requirement
chunks.text:
This change covers two requirements:
• Partial Indents against projection quantities
In this case upon receipt of customer projection, Shahi team creates Sales Order with partial quantities covering certain percentage like 80% of projection quantities. The team also puts a size-wise breakup of this 80% quantity based on previous sales orders received in season or one year.
This projection size breakup works on subcategory level.
In this case, material indents are generated only for 80% of customer projection quantities,
• Partial Procurement against projection quantities
In this case, sales orders are created for 100% projection quantities with or without size breakup. Size breakup. Indents are created for whole quantity but procurement is restricted for certain percentage based on materials.
As of now, this is managed by manual communication and manual approvals.
• Automation of MRP run based on conditions
This requirement is to automate MRP execution based on given changes in BOM and Sales Orders.
• Option to define percentage of procurement control
There is a need to define procurement percentage against material which will control supplier purchase order quantity to given percentage even if indents has open quantities.
• Bypass indent and procurement controls
chunks.locator: § Business Requirement

chunks.title: Business Requirement

chunks.text: There should be a day count post which system should run MRP at 100% in case of indent control and should allow sourcing team to create/ revise supplier PO to 100% of indents quantities with handling on MOQ, MSQ & MCQ.

chunks.title: MRP Percentage Control
chunks.heading: Functional Requirement. › Auto MRP – New Addition – 15-Sep-26 › MRP Percentage Control
chunks.text:
• Splitter options required before Buyer, department, product group, sub category, Material category, Material product group, Material sub-category.
New Addition – 15-Sep-26
• By Default, system will generate MRP to the percentage defined under “MRP%” of above grid.
• This percentage will be followed up to the days given “MRP Release Days”. MRP release days will be calculated from First MRP Run Date. For example if “MRP Release Days” is set to 20 and First MRP run date is 1st Sep 2026 then will automatically make MRP % as 100 on 21st Sep 2026.
• In case a buyer entry is defined in this grid bur percentage is not defined for a respective material product group or Subcategory then system will run MRP for that product group or subcategory for 100% of required quantity.
• In case buyer is selected in “Auto MRL/MRP Config” grid but not defined in “MRP Execution” grid then system will run MRP on 100%
=============================
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirement. › Auto MRP – New Addition – 15-Sep-26 › MRP Percentage Control

chunks.title: Changes in MRP Screen
chunks.heading: Functional Requirement. › Changes in MRP Screen
chunks.text: There will be a few changes in the MRP screen in line with above requested function. At the time of MRP run system will show material MRP % as per grid specified, if not then system will show % as 100%. It will auto calculate MRP Qty based on the percentage specified in “MRP %” column. The quantity in “MRP Qty” will be used for Indent generation.
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirement. › Changes in MRP Screen

chunks.title: Step 1: BOM Selection during OC Creation via EDI Buyer PO
chunks.heading: Functional Requirement. › MRP Automation › Process Flow › Step 1: BOM Selection during OC Creation via EDI Buyer PO
chunks.text:
While creating the OC from the EDI Buyer PO, the system should handle BOM selection as follows:
• If multiple BOMs are available for the article, the system should allow the user to select the required BOM from the list.
• If only one BOM is available, the system should automatically attach the BOM in the EDI screen without requiring user selection.
• The system should display only those BOMs which are in Approved status for selection or auto-attachment.
• Only one BOM (Bill of Materials) should be allowed to be attached to a single Summary OC.
• Only In case of any revision in the OC, the system should automatically re-run the MRP to reflect the updated requirements.
In the above screen you can see BOM will be selected while creating the OC.
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirement. › MRP Automation › Process Flow › Step 1: BOM Selection during OC Creation via EDI Buyer PO

chunks.title: MRP Scheduler Configuration (Backend Controlled)
chunks.heading: Functional Requirement. › MRP Automation › Process Flow › Step 2: Auto MRP › MRP Scheduler Configuration (Backend Controlled)
chunks.text:
• The MRP scheduler will be configured at the backend only, and no UI/screen will be provided to users for scheduler configuration.
• The system will automatically trigger MRP runs based on backend-defined schedules.
• In case of OC revision MRP should re-run automatically.
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirement. › MRP Automation › Process Flow › Step 2: Auto MRP › MRP Scheduler Configuration (Backend Controlled)

chunks.title: Error Handling and Monitoring for MRP Run
chunks.heading: Functional Requirement. › MRP Automation › Process Flow › Step 2: Auto MRP › Error Handling and Monitoring for MRP Run
chunks.text:
• In case of any error during MRP execution, the system should capture and log the error details.
• A separate screen should be provided for users to monitor MRP run errors.
• This screen should display:
• Article / OC reference
• MRP run date and time
• Execution status (Success/Failed)
• Detailed error messages
• Users should be able to analyze the errors and take corrective actions from this screen.
• The system should also allow users to reprocess/re-run MRP after resolving the issues.
• Additionally, users should have the provision to manually trigger MRP for specific articles/OCs in urgent scenarios, even before the scheduled run.
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirement. › MRP Automation › Process Flow › Step 2: Auto MRP › Error Handling and Monitoring for MRP Run

chunks.title: MRP in Saved mode and Editing
chunks.heading: Functional Requirement. › MRP Auto Re-run in Case OF SOC Revision and BOM Revision › … › MRP in Saved mode and Editing
chunks.text:
In MRP scheduler queue, Auto-Trigger MRP will be kept in saved if MRP % percentage is taken from MRP % grid and has MRP % less than 100% for any MRP item.
In such case, user will be able to edit MRP % using edit option provided against MRP Job ID. Upon review and required changes, user will select MRP Job ID and confirm for processing using “CONFIRM” button on Queue header.
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirement. › MRP Auto Re-run in Case OF SOC Revision and BOM Revision › … › MRP in Saved mode and Editing
